words.definition: vt. 养育，培育；扶持 n. 养育；环境作用

examples.en: Parents should nurture their children's curiosity from an early age.
examples.zh: 父母应从小培养孩子的好奇心。

examples.en: The program aims to nurture young talent in rural areas.
examples.zh: 该项目旨在培养农村地区的年轻人才。

words.usage: 及物动词，培养人才、呵护关系：nurture talent；名词用于 nature versus nurture 先天与后天之辩；口语近义 bring up。
collocations: nurture talent 培养人才
nature and nurture 先天与后天
nurture a relationship 呵护关系
words.mnemonic: nurse 护士般照料 → nurture 养育培养

words.definition: n. 性情，性格；倾向；处置，安排

examples.en: She has a cheerful disposition and gets along with everyone.
examples.zh: 她性情开朗，与所有人都相处融洽。

examples.en: The court announced the final disposition of the case.
examples.zh: 法庭宣布了该案的最终处理结果。

words.usage: 名词多义：性情 a cheerful disposition；倾向 a disposition to do；法律义处置财产；与 disposal 侧重不同，注意区分。
collocations: a cheerful disposition 开朗的性格
a disposition to do 做某事的倾向
the disposition of assets 资产处置
words.mnemonic: dispose(安排)+ition → 上天安排的性情

words.definition: adj. 谨慎的，审慎的；不显眼的

examples.en: We made discreet inquiries about his business background.
examples.zh: 我们审慎地打听了他的商业背景。

examples.en: Please be discreet about the merger talks until the official announcement.
examples.zh: 在正式公布之前，请对合并谈判保密。

words.usage: 形容词，指言行谨慎、不张扬；be discreet about sth 对某事保密；派生 discretion 谨慎；与同音词 discrete 分离的严格区分。
collocations: be discreet about 对…谨慎保密
a discreet inquiry 秘密打听
discreet support 暗中支持
words.mnemonic: 藏 ee 像眯眼细看 → discreet 谨慎的

words.definition: n. 庄园；房地产；遗产；住宅区

examples.en: The family owns a large estate in the countryside.
examples.zh: 这家人在乡下拥有一座大庄园。

examples.en: Real estate prices in the city have doubled in five years.
examples.zh: 五年间这座城市的房地产价格翻了一番。

words.usage: real estate 房地产；housing estate 英式住宅区；estate agent 房产中介；法律义遗产：personal estate 动产遗产。
collocations: real estate 房地产
housing estate 住宅区
estate agent 房产中介
words.mnemonic: e+state(州) → 一州之地 → 庄园地产

words.definition: n. 小屋，旅舍 v. 借宿；正式提出；卡住

examples.en: The hikers spent the night in a mountain lodge.
examples.zh: 徒步者们在山间小屋过夜。

examples.en: The tenant lodged a formal complaint about the heating system.
examples.zh: 租户就供暖系统提出了正式投诉。

words.usage: 动词多义：借宿 lodge with sb；正式提出 lodge a complaint 投诉，高频；异物卡住 lodge in；派生 lodger 房客。
collocations: lodge a complaint 提出投诉
lodge with sb 借宿某人家
a mountain lodge 山间小屋
words.mnemonic: 谐音「落居」→ 落脚安居 → 小屋；借宿

words.definition: n. 人工制品，文物；（数据）异常产物

examples.en: The museum displays artifacts unearthed from the ancient tomb.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了古墓出土的文物。

examples.en: Archaeologists dated the artifact to the Bronze Age.
examples.zh: 考古学家测定该文物属于青铜时代。

words.usage: 名词，人工制品、文物，英式亦拼 artefact；常搭 unearthed artifacts 出土文物；考古类阅读高频；近义 relic 更泛。
collocations: ancient artifacts 古代文物
unearth an artifact 出土文物
a cultural artifact 文化产物
words.mnemonic: arti(技艺)+fact(制) → 人工制成 → 文物

words.definition: n. 处理，清除；支配，处置权

examples.en: The city built new plants for the disposal of household waste.
examples.zh: 该市新建了几座生活垃圾处理厂。

examples.en: A team of legal experts was placed at his disposal.
examples.zh: 一队法律专家供他调遣。

words.usage: waste disposal 垃圾处理；固定短语 at sb's disposal 任凭某人支配，考研高频；源自 dispose of；与 disposition 词义分流。
collocations: waste disposal 废物处理
at one's disposal 供…支配
garbage disposal 垃圾处理装置
words.mnemonic: dispose 去 e 加 al → 处理；清除

words.definition: n. 机车，火车头 adj. 运动的；机车的

examples.en: The old steam locomotive is now displayed in the railway museum.
examples.zh: 那辆老式蒸汽机车如今陈列在铁路博物馆里。

examples.en: Electric locomotives gradually replaced steam engines on the line.
examples.zh: 电力机车逐渐取代了这条线路上的蒸汽机车。

words.usage: 名词机车、火车头；形容词运动的、移动的；loco 地方加 motive 动的；派生 locomotion n. 运动；蒸汽机车为常见搭配。
collocations: a steam locomotive 蒸汽机车
electric locomotives 电力机车
locomotive power 机车牵引力
words.mnemonic: loco(地方)+motive(动) → 移地而行 → 火车头

words.definition: n. 经度，经线；（天文）黄经

examples.en: The ship reported its latitude and longitude to the base every hour.
examples.zh: 船只每小时向基地报告一次经纬度。

examples.en: The island lies at 120 degrees east longitude.
examples.zh: 该岛位于东经120度。

words.usage: 不可数名词，经度：east longitude 东经、west longitude 西经；与 latitude 纬度成对记忆；latitude 另有自由度之义。
collocations: east longitude 东经
latitude and longitude 经纬度
the line of longitude 经线
words.mnemonic: long(纵长) → 纵向量的线 → 经度

words.definition: vt. 尊重，敬重 n. 尊重，好评

examples.en: She is held in high esteem by colleagues and students alike.
examples.zh: 她深受同事和学生的敬重。

examples.en: The professor is esteemed for his contributions to linguistics.
examples.zh: 这位教授因对语言学的贡献而受人敬重。

words.usage: 及物动词，尊敬，多被动：be highly esteemed；名词 hold sb in high esteem；self-esteem 自尊，心理学写作双高频。
collocations: self-esteem 自尊
hold sb in high esteem 高度尊敬
be esteemed as 被尊为
words.mnemonic: estimate 估量人 → 估得高即敬重

words.definition: n. 悲剧；惨事，灾难；悲剧体裁

examples.en: The earthquake was a national tragedy that claimed thousands of lives.
examples.zh: 那场地震是夺去数千人生命的全国性灾难。

examples.en: Hamlet is one of the greatest tragedies in world literature.
examples.zh: 《哈姆雷特》是世界文学中最伟大的悲剧之一。

words.usage: 名词，兼指悲剧作品与惨事；a sense of tragedy 悲剧感；tragedy strikes 悲剧降临；形容词 tragic；反义 comedy。
collocations: a national tragedy 全国性灾难
a sense of tragedy 悲剧感
end in tragedy 以悲剧收场
words.mnemonic: 与 comedy 喜剧对反 → tragedy 悲剧惨事

words.definition: vt. 使摆脱，使去掉，解除

examples.en: The new policy aims to rid the city of chronic pollution.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在让城市摆脱长期污染。

examples.en: She was glad to be rid of all those unnecessary meetings.
examples.zh: 她很高兴摆脱了所有那些不必要的会议。

words.usage: 及物动词，几乎只用于固定搭配：rid A of B 使摆脱；get rid of 摆脱，口语高频；be rid of 表摆脱后的状态；三态同形 rid。
collocations: get rid of 摆脱
rid sb of sth 使摆脱
be rid of 已摆脱
words.mnemonic: 谐音「锐一低」→ 锐刀割断拖累 → 摆脱

words.definition: n. 底部，末端；臀部 adj. 最低的 v. 触底

examples.en: The keys had fallen to the bottom of her handbag.
examples.zh: 钥匙掉到了她手提包的底部。

examples.en: House prices finally bottomed out at the end of the crisis.
examples.zh: 房价在危机尾声终于触底。

words.usage: at the bottom of 在底部；from top to bottom 彻头彻尾；bottom out 触底回升，经济类高频；the bottom line 底线、要旨。
collocations: at the bottom of 在…底部
bottom out 触底
from top to bottom 从上到下
words.mnemonic: bot+tom 瓶分两截 → tom 在下 → 底部

words.definition: vi. 盛行，流行；获胜，占上风；说服

examples.en: Strong winds prevailed along the coast throughout the weekend.
examples.zh: 整个周末沿海地区一直狂风大作。

examples.en: Justice will prevail over injustice in the end.
examples.zh: 正义终将战胜非正义。

words.usage: 不及物动词：prevail over 战胜、prevail in/among 盛行；prevail on sb to do 说服；派生 prevailing、prevalent 均高频。
collocations: prevail over 战胜
the prevailing view 主流观点
prevail on sb to do 说服某人做
words.mnemonic: pre(前)+vail(力) → 力量居前 → 占上风

words.definition: vi. 干涉，干预；妨碍，干扰

examples.en: No country has the right to interfere in others' internal affairs.
examples.zh: 任何国家都无权干涉他国内政。

examples.en: The noise from the party interfered with his research.
examples.zh: 派对的噪音干扰了他的研究。

words.usage: 不及物动词，必接介词：interfere in 干涉、interfere with 妨碍，完形高频辨析；名词 interference；近义 intervene 介入。
collocations: interfere in 干涉
interfere with 妨碍
interfere with each other 相互干扰
words.mnemonic: inter(之间)+fere(带) → 把自己带入他人之间 → 干涉

words.definition: n. 环，圈；循环；环状物 v. 成环

examples.en: The river makes a wide loop around the ancient town.
examples.zh: 河流绕着古镇拐出一个大弯。

examples.en: Keep me in the loop about any changes to the schedule.
examples.zh: 日程若有任何变动，请随时让我知情。

words.usage: 名词环、圈、循环；be in the loop 掌握内情、out of the loop 被蒙在鼓里，职场高频；动词指绕成环、使成回路。
collocations: be in the loop 知情
a loop of rope 绳圈
loop back 折返
words.mnemonic: 两个 o 连成一串圈 → loop 环；循环

words.definition: vt. 定罪，宣判…有罪 n. 囚犯

examples.en: The jury convicted him of fraud after a six-week trial.
examples.zh: 经过六周审理，陪审团判他诈骗罪成立。

examples.en: The escaped convict was recaptured within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 那名越狱囚犯在二十四小时内被再次抓获。

words.usage: 重音分词性：动词定罪读 kənˈvɪkt，名词囚犯读 ˈkɒnvɪkt，经典考点；名词 conviction 兼指定罪与坚定信念；近义 sentence。
collocations: convict sb of 定某人有罪
an escaped convict 越狱犯
a convicted criminal 已定罪的犯人
words.mnemonic: con+vict(征服) → 被法律征服 → 定罪；囚犯

words.definition: v. （使）消散，驱散；挥霍，浪费

examples.en: The morning fog dissipated as the sun climbed higher.
examples.zh: 随着太阳升高，晨雾渐渐消散。

examples.en: His enthusiasm dissipated once the initial excitement wore off.
examples.zh: 初期的新鲜劲一过，他的热情便消散了。

words.usage: 及物与不及物兼用：The wind dissipated the clouds；引申挥霍 dissipate one's savings；派生 dissipation；近义 disperse。
collocations: dissipate heat 散热
dissipate the fog 驱散雾气
dissipate one's savings 挥霍积蓄
words.mnemonic: dis(散)+sip(小口)+ate → 一口口喝光 → 消散

words.definition: n. 靴子；（英）汽车后备箱；v. 启动（计算机），猛踢

examples.en: She laced up her boots and stepped into the deep snow.
examples.zh: 她系紧靴子，踏进深深的积雪。

examples.en: The computer refused to boot after the power cut.
examples.zh: 断电之后，这台电脑无法启动。

words.usage: 名词指靴子，英式特指汽车后备箱（美式用 trunk）；动词指猛踢，以及启动计算机 boot up the system；习语 give sb the boot 意为解雇、抛弃某人。

synonyms.note: 美式说后备箱；boot 为英式
鞋的统称；boot 特指高帮靴

collocations: a pair of boots 一双靴子
boot up the computer 启动电脑
give sb the boot 解雇某人
words.mnemonic: 靴子 boot→用靴子踢一脚，电脑被「踢」醒即启动

words.definition: v. 设法做到；策划，谋划；设计，造出

examples.en: Somehow she contrived to finish the thesis on time.
examples.zh: 她想方设法按时完成了论文。

examples.en: The committee contrived a compromise that satisfied both sides.
examples.zh: 委员会炮制出一个令双方都满意的折中方案。

words.usage: 常接不定式 contrive to do sth，指想方设法办成某事；也可说 contrive a plan 炮制方案，含心机意味。派生：contrived adj. 矫揉造作的。

confusables.note: 源自；首字母 d，义为来源

collocations: contrive to do sth 设法做成某事
contrive a scheme 策划阴谋
a contrived ending 矫揉造作的结局
words.mnemonic: con(共同)+trive(扭转)→扭转局面→设法做成；含心机
